statements.t: Based on our current operational performance, we believe our working capital of approximately $44,933,000 and available borrowings under our existing credit facility will provide sufficient liquidity to meet our anticipated working capital and other liquidity needs for the next twelve months from the date of this report.
We currently expect to finance planned equipment purchases with cash flows from operations or borrowings under our credit facility.
We will continue to evaluate our projected expenditures relative to our available cash and evaluate financing alternatives to satisfy our working capital and other cash requirements.
